svg.title: Aurum Maze: the 1980 arcade maze in gold line.
svg.desc: Animated banner. A gold-line Pac-Man maze draws itself on the right. Pac-Man runs along a corridor chased by four ghosts, then turns the tables and chases four frightened blue ghosts back. Title and three feature pills on the left.
